name: Nautilus
notes: Casts go one at a time: a single busy_until tracks the champion's current cast. Depth Charge (R) opens the fight at t=0 with its 0.46s cast time (its damage is all later events, not on-cast), then Dredge Line (Q, 0.25s cast) and Riptide (E, 0.25s cast) each keep Nautilus busy for their own cast time before the next cast or attack can start; Titan's Wrath (W) has no cast time so it costs nothing but still cannot start inside another ability's cast.
Opens with R (Depth Charge) at t=0 since its 80-120s cooldown means it can be cast only once inside the fight.

Depth Charge is modeled as one underway eruption (secondary damage) followed by the final eruption (primary/increased damage), assuming a melee-range ~125-unit engagement so the charge reaches the target in about 0.35s per its stated acceleration formula (275 + 466.67/s); this is an assumption because the true distance depends on where R is cast from.

Q (Dredge Line) is cast on cooldown; its damage lands as the cast starts and then its 0.25s cast time keeps Nautilus busy, the same simplification used for the drag/dash which is not modeled beyond that lockout.

W (Titan's Wrath) is cast on cooldown (no cast time), immediately raising its 6s shield; per the wiki, reapplying Pain of Wrath while one is already ticking adds a stack but deals no extra damage, so only the first attack landing during each shield window deals Pain of Wrath's damage (half instantly, half 1.25s later) — but every attack landing during the shield window still resets Nautilus' attack timer, so attacks chain much faster while it is up.

E (Riptide) is cast on cooldown; all three of its waves (at 0, 0.297s and 0.561s after the cast) are assumed to hit the stationary dummy, with the second and third waves reduced to 50% damage as stated; the cast itself keeps Nautilus busy for its 0.25s cast time.
Staggering Blow (P) adds its bonus physical damage to a basic attack landing on the dummy at most once every 6 seconds, since the dummy is the only target.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here realistically binds inside a 15s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: Depth Charge's chase distance to a stationary dummy depends on cast range; assumed a melee-range 125-unit engagement since Nautilus typically closes in with Q/auto-attacks before casting R
travel time for the charge to cover the assumed 125-unit distance, derived from the ability's stated speed formula 275 + 466.67 units/s
